title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs Entry Requirements Matrix
content:
The entry requirements that apply to each program type of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs are set out in the matrix below; each row is one requirement and each column one program type.

| Setting | Kestrel Rx Discount Card | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family | Manufacturer Copay Card | Manufacturer Bridge Program | Charitable Foundation Copay Grant |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Requires active commercial prescription coverage | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Not usable while the fill is billed to a government plan | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Applies only while prior authorization is pending or denied | No | No | No | No | Yes | No |
| Enrollment needs a received or active Kestrel prescription for the drug | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Minimum age of the enrolling patient (whole years) | 0 | 18 | 18 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Household income attestation at enrollment | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Income limit (percent of the federal poverty level; 0 means no income test) | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 500% |
| Most open enrollments of this program type per drug | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Most people covered by one enrollment | 1 | 1 | 5 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Every covered member must live at the enrolling patient's home address | No | No | Yes | No | No | No |

## Definitions used in the matrix

- **Commercial coverage** — active commercial prescription coverage held by the patient.
- **Government plan** — a prescription plan of a government class; the row states whether the program cannot be used while the fill is billed to one.
- **Prior authorization pending or denied** — the program applies only while the patient's prior authorization for the drug is pending or denied.
- **Minimum age** — measured in whole years of the enrolling patient; 0 means no minimum is set.
- **Income limit** — the highest household income, as a percent of the federal poverty level, that qualifies; the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant sets 500% and requires the attestation, every other program type shows 0 (no income test).
- **Open enrollments per drug** — every program type allows 1.
- **Covered members** — one enrollment covers 1 person, except the Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family, which covers up to 5 people who must all share the enrolling patient's home address.

## Quick comparisons

- Program types requiring commercial coverage: Manufacturer Copay Card and Manufacturer Bridge Program.
- Program types needing a Kestrel prescription for the drug: Manufacturer Copay Card, Manufacturer Bridge Program and Charitable Foundation Copay Grant.
- Program types with an age minimum: both Kestrel Rx Savings Club memberships, 18 years.
